lines.hook: Our Kopa ballot put Pau Cubarsí first. Lamine Yamal won it, and said on stage the prize should have been Cubarsí's.
stats: Yamal: a third Kopa in a row, the first player to win it three times. We said he most likely would.
Cubarsí, our first: second on the jury's ballot.
And Lennart Karl, ninth of ten by his EA FC twenty-seven card, finished fourth.
lines.contrast: Yamal was our second and the jury's first. Our third, Yan Diomande, finished fifth.
lines.quote: Yamal, on Cubarsí: this prize should have been for him.
lines.close: We keep the receipts. The full read is on scoutgamer.com.
